verdict.rationale: Intel's first-party marketing claims the chip handles 'long edits, and heavy exports' even unplugged, with 'intelligent power management' and 'smart power efficiency.' These are only vague vendor claims: no power envelope figures or sustained-load behavior are documented. Missing for 10: documented power envelopes (base/turbo power, sustained limits), any data on throttling during long renders or exports, independent or hands-on testing of sustained performance per watt.
